description.value:
As part of the action used to cast this power, you must make a melee weapon attack against a creature within your reach, or the power fails. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage, and if you were hidden from the target, it also takes 1d4 poison damage.

At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 poison damage, and the damage dealt while hidden increases to 2d4; both increase again by 1d8 and 1d4, respectively, at 11th and 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
